title: Error Creating a Wigglechart on Sharepoint
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
When you open your schedule via Sharepoint and run Wigglechart to create your first Wigglechart, fastProject will crash with an error something like “https://xxx.sharepoint.com/sites/…/https:/xxx.sharepoint.com/sites/… Wigglechart.xlsm”.

fastProject does not currently support creating a Wigglechart if your schedule was opened via Sharepoint. As a workaround, you should:

  • Copy the .mpp file to your local machine, e.g. Desktop

Copy the .mpp file to your local machine, e.g. Desktop

  • Run the Wigglechart which will create the Wigglechart

Run the Wigglechart which will create the Wigglechart

  • Save and exit both the Wigglechart and .mpp file

Save and exit both the Wigglechart and .mpp file

  • Copy both the .mpp file and Wigglechart back to Sharepoint

Copy both the .mpp file and Wigglechart back to Sharepoint

From then on, running the Wigglechart when the schedule is opened via Sharepoint will work.
